research_outcome: BOUNDED_SUPPORTED — near the 1600 horizon, Sámi communities in several northern jurisdictions were subjected to coercive state taxation, sovereignty enforcement and bounded war/capture pressures; internal Sámi slavery/slaveholding at the anchor remains unestablished
bounded_proposition: Around 1600, some Sámi communities were subjected to overlapping Swedish, Danish-Norwegian and Russian fiscal/jurisdictional claims, including punishment-backed tax-allegiance enforcement and controlled trade; bounded late-sixteenth-century capture/displacement is also supported. Internal Sámi slavery is not established.
required_abstention: Do not infer one Sámi polity/regime, taxation=slavery, Crown employment=forced labour, capture=enslavement, later mining corvée at 1600, internal Sámi slaveholding, uniform prevalence, or a modern Sápmi practice polygon.
evidence_locus: Swedish Ume/Lule/Kemi lappmark taxation and policy; Danish-Norwegian Sea Sámi fiscal incorporation; eastern Kuusamo/Karelia capture context; broader Swedish elite service context.
inference_extent: Bounded state-imposed coercive extraction in specific jurisdictions and capture/displacement in specific borderlands; no Sápmi-wide or internal-slavery inference.
law_practice_note: State fiscal/jurisdictional coercion is supported, but tax/service status is not converted into slave/property status. Later seventeenth-century mining corvée is temporal control only.
network_territorial_note: Overlapping Swedish, Danish-Norwegian and Russian claims remain separate; external/state coercion does not become internal Sámi practice.
historical_terms: siida; skatt/tax; leidang; lappmark (historical administrative term); Crown service
category_mapping_note: Taxpayer, Crown employee, captive, servant and slave/property status are kept distinct. Internal Sámi slaveholding remains unestablished; supported dimension is state-imposed coercive extraction and bounded capture/displacement.
language_access_limitations: Core scholarship available in English/Norwegian/Swedish-facing publications; state records are accessed through specialist studies. No exhaustive Sámi-, Russian-, Swedish- or Danish-language archive review.
geometry_claim_role: Regional/community navigation only; not evidence of coercion extent.
geometry_unresolved_note: Modern Sápmi, historical lappmarks, siida areas and overlapping state claims are different geometries; no practice polygon authorized.
